lines.t:
The <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> or <c:ffff00>{{object}}<c> affected by an <c:ffff00>act<c>.

When choosing commands, if there are multiple
opponents and the {{effect}} targets only one, the
target is chosen after choosing the act.

When the act is executed, if the target is <c:ffff00>knocked<c>
<c:ffff00>out<c> or otherwise in an unsuitable state, the {{medabot}}
itself decides to change the target.
